ui.title:
Find
Your
Program
ui.lede: Stamp the square that sounds like you. Fill your card, shout bingo, meet your stream.
ui.fine: {n} questions, about two minutes. At the end we ask for your name, email and phone number so we can tell you when applications open.
ui.scaleAsk: How much is this like you?
ui.cardHint: Each stream owns one line through the star. Fill it and shout bingo.
ui.idle: Back to the welcome screen in {s} seconds for the next visitor.

steps.apply: Applications open after Al Sharq Forum 2026. Leave your details on the 2027 interest form. Network members get special places.
steps.under18: Join your local hub now. {stream} is one to apply to when you turn 18.
steps.over35: Contribute to a hub as a professional: mentor, speak or train. Pass {stream} on to a friend.
steps.lowTime: Start at your local hub. {stream} asks 5 to 10 hours a week, so keep it for when you have more time.

free-evening.q: On a free evening, where are you most likely to be?

answers.a: In a library, reading our history
answers.b: At a café, deep in conversation
answers.c: At my desk, building a project

ummah-crisis.q: When a crisis hits part of the Ummah, what do you do first?

answers.b: Design a practical way to help
answers.d: Help people around me understand it

group-role.q: In group work, you’re usually the one who…

answers.a: Unites the team on one goal
answers.b: Turns the idea into a plan
answers.c: Gets it done in the end

friends-ask.q: Friends usually come to you for…

ummah-challenges.q: When you think about the Ummah’s challenges, you…

answers.b: Want to start something that helps
answers.c: Want youth to have a say
answers.d: Want to act with my community

weekend.q: A weekend you’d call well spent…

answers.a: A good book and a discussion

answers.b: Sharing what I learn with others

good-leader.q: For you, a good leader mostly…

small-grant.q: If your community got a small grant, you’d…

answers.b: Design a project with clear goals
answers.c: Test a small idea right away

next-year.q: What would make next year worth it?

answers.c: Finding a community I belong to

statements.why-first: I want to understand why the Ummah is where it is today.
statements.conversations: I enjoy deep conversations with young people from across the Ummah.
statements.direction: When my team or friends can’t agree, I help us find common ground.
statements.sketch-fix: When I see a problem facing the Ummah, I start thinking about how to solve it.
statements.idea-project: I have an idea for an initiative that could serve the Ummah.
statements.show-up: When I organise an activity for my community, people join in.
statements.decisions: I want to be part of the change the Ummah needs, starting in my own community.
statements.local-group: I want a local group where we meet, talk and work for the Ummah.
statements.build-learn: I like testing an idea quickly to see if it works.
statements.public-life: I’d like to start an awareness campaign with my community about an issue facing the Ummah.

time.q: Honestly, how many hours a week could you give?

big.name: The Big-Picture Thinker
big.line: You always ask why, and connect the dots.

dial.name: The Conversation Starter
dial.line: You think best by talking it through.

lead.name: The Steady Leader
lead.line: People look to you, and you listen first.

design.name: The Problem Solver
design.line: You see a problem and sketch a fix.

launch.name: The Starter
launch.line: You’d rather build it than talk about it.

mobil.name: The Rallier
mobil.line: When it matters, you get people moving.

civic.name: The Change Seeker
civic.line: You want to know who decides, and why.

hub.name: The Bridge Builder
hub.line: You turn where you live into a community.
